name: Event Ingestion & Analytics Engine
description: High-throughput event tracking pipeline with batched writes, time-series aggregations, funnel analysis, and real-time dashboard queries.

clarifying_questions.question: Analytics storage engine?
clarifying_questions.impacts: Sets up database connection pool and columnar table partitioning

clarifying_questions.question: Event ingestion pipeline?
options: Direct HTTP endpoint with Redis memory buffer
clarifying_questions.impacts: Adds ingestion buffer worker to prevent database write lock

known_failure_modes: Writing individual event rows directly to SQL database on every single web event
Lack of database table partitioning by time (e.g. daily/monthly partitions) causing slow range scans
Unbounded JSONB indexing on arbitrary event payload properties
